verses.text: Elihu also continued, and said,
“Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
lines: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you;
for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

verses.text: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
lines: I will get my knowledge from afar,
and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.text: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
lines: For truly my words are not false.
One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

verses.text: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
lines: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone.
He is mighty in strength of understanding.

verses.text: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
lines: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked,
but gives justice to the afflicted.

verses.text: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
lines: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous,
but with kings on the throne,
he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

verses.text: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
lines: If they are bound in fetters,
and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

verses.text: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
lines: then he shows them their work,
and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

verses.text: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
lines: He also opens their ears to instruction,
and commands that they return from iniquity.

verses.text: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
lines: If they listen and serve him,
they will spend their days in prosperity,
and their years in pleasures.

verses.text: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
lines: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword;
they will die without knowledge.

verses.text: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
lines: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger.
They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

verses.text: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
lines: They die in youth.
Their life perishes among the unclean.

verses.text: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
lines: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction,
and opens their ear in oppression.

verses.text: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
lines: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress,
into a wide place, where there is no restriction.
That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

verses.text: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
lines: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked.
Judgment and justice take hold of you.

verses.text: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
lines: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath,
neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

verses.text: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
lines: Would your wealth sustain you in distress,
or all the might of your strength?

verses.text: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
lines: Don’t desire the night,
when people are cut off in their place.

verses.text: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
lines: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity;
for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

verses.text: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
lines: Behold, God is exalted in his power.
Who is a teacher like him?

verses.text: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
lines: Who has prescribed his way for him?
Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’

verses.text: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
lines: “Remember that you magnify his work,
about which men have sung.

verses.text: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
lines: All men have looked on it.
Man sees it afar off.

verses.text: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
lines: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him.
The number of his years is unsearchable.

verses.text: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
lines: For he draws up the drops of water,
which distill in rain from his vapor,

verses.text: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
lines: which the skies pour down
and which drop on man abundantly.

verses.text: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
lines: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds,
and the thunderings of his pavilion?

verses.text: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
lines: Behold, he spreads his light around him.
He covers the bottom of the sea.

verses.text: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
lines: For by these he judges the people.
He gives food in abundance.

verses.text: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
lines: He covers his hands with the lightning,
and commands it to strike the mark.

verses.text: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
lines: Its noise tells about him,
and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.
